Artist.value: Alphonse de Neuville

ImageDescription.value: Painting by Alphonse-Marie-Adolphe de Neuville, 1873: Les dernières cartouches (The last cartridges). French snipers ambush Bavarian troops, hiding in the l'Auberge Bourgerie in Bazeilles, prior to the Battle of Sedan during the Franco-Prussian War in 1870.
